phase_prompt.label: The Observer State
phase_prompt.summary: The souls stand at the precipice of the system's mechanics, witnessing the backend operations of the universe. They are silent, heavy with realization, their glass forms refracting the cold light of the machine.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic wide shot from behind a group of translucent glass humanoids standing on a vast, reflective black platform. They are looking out towards a massive, towering vertical gate structure made of dark metal and light. The figures are grounded, their reflections sharp on the floor. Their internal cyan light is steady and calm. The camera focus is deep, capturing the scale of the environment compared to the figures. The atmosphere is thick, with subtle particulate matter catching the light. The mood is solemn, awe-inspiring, and quiet, rendered with the fidelity of a high-budget sci-fi drama.
